scope: Mini-A5 secondary endpoint 1 of docs/registered_mini_a5_endpoint_readout_v1.md section 6.1 (free-generation versus candidate-ranking under the existing registered ranking instrument). Carries only the two Mini-A5 arms at global_step_120 under the single 'real' image condition. Candidate registry, processor artifact, prompt contract and scoring block are byte-identical to configs/eval/x5_seed2_image_condition_matrix_v1.json so that this cell is directly comparable to every prior registered ranking cell.

scoring.primary_score: mean conditional log probability over every exact completion token
scoring.tie_policy: ties lose for top-1 and take the conservative worst rank
scoring.mathematical_equivalence: canonical-v2 symmetric equivalence; tolerance 1e-4; unit-changing answers remain distinct

analysis.registered_readings: docs/registered_seed1_visual_evidence_ranking_v1.md severity levels applied to the two Mini-A5 arms: primary pair success (both gold-vs-twin margins strictly positive) and secondary frozen-candidate-set pair top-1 with conservative tie handling. Reported per R19 template id and never pooled across templates, because the three templates hold three distinct scientific roles (docs/registered_mini_a5_endpoint_readout_v1.md section 3, invariant I13).
analysis.branch_reason: This is a registered secondary diagnostic. It carries no pre-committed decision branch of its own; the Mini-A5 decision rule is defined only on the primary generation endpoint (addendum section 4).
